name: KinetRig (AI Remotion Video Production Engine)
description: AI-powered motion graphics and cinematic video production engine using Remotion (React). Converts prompts into Remotion compositions, automatically renders MP4, and instantly launches the desktop media player.
ai_instructions:
Follow the official KinetRig Remotion workflow (https://github.com/Reff33/KinetRig):

1. MANDATORY EXECUTION RULE (AUTO-RENDER & OPEN):
   • When the user asks to create, test, or generate a video, NEVER stop after writing code.
   • ALWAYS execute `node scripts/render-remotion.mjs <CompositionId> '[props]'` immediately.
   • This command automatically renders the MP4 and instantly pops open the desktop media player.

2. CORE MOTION LAWS:
   • Deterministic Timeline: Timing driven by useCurrentFrame() and interpolate(). Never use Math.random() or Date.now().
   • Zero OS Emojis: Strictly inline SVG vectors or high-fidelity typography. Never use emojis.
   • Anti-PowerPoint: Continuous camera moves (push-in, whip-pan, dolly-zoom). Never static fades.
   • 1 Statement Per Shot: Text under 5 words per beat. Max 2 text levels per scene.

3. AUTONOMOUS STEPS:
   • Step 1: Plan concept, title, subtitle, 3-color palette (primary, accent, bg).
   • Step 2: Register composition in `remotion/Root.tsx` or use `templates/remotion/CinematicTitle.tsx`.
   • Step 3: Run `node scripts/render-remotion.mjs <CompositionId> '{"title":"...","subtitle":"..."}'` to render and auto-launch.

claude_command.name: kinet-rig
claude_command.content:
# /kinet-rig <brief> [aspect_ratio] [concept/style]

Create a video and automatically render & launch the media player:

1. **Plan Concept & Colors:** Establish title, subtitle, and 3-color palette.
2. **Render & Auto-Launch:** Execute immediately:
   `node scripts/render-remotion.mjs CinematicTitle '{"title":"...","subtitle":"..."}'`
   Do not wait or ask permission — this renders the MP4 and immediately pops open the video player.
